lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: This is how Kairos works, under the hood.
lines.en: This is how Kairos works, under the hood.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every borrower lives in one record. Loans, payments, replies, consent. Money is kept to the paisa.
lines.en: Every borrower lives in one record. Loans, payments, replies, consent. Money is kept to the paisa.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every day, and on every event, the churn engine re-sorts each borrower. Their cohort, their risk, their step in the journey, and the layer of contact. Pay, or say stop, and they leave the journey at once.
lines.en: Every day, and on every event, the churn engine re-sorts each borrower. Their cohort, their risk, their step in the journey, and the layer of contact. Pay, or say stop, and they leave the journey at once.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: A learning model scores every channel and every hour for them, using what worked for similar borrowers in their region, and for them personally.
lines.en: A learning model scores every channel and every hour for them, using what worked for similar borrowers in their region, and for them personally.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Before a message is queued, Aladdin reserves the budget and the contact limit. At the moment of sending, it checks the rules again.
lines.en: Before a message is queued, Aladdin reserves the budget and the contact limit. At the moment of sending, it checks the rules again.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Messages go out through each channel's API. Delivery, read and reply receipts come back as webhooks. Duplicates are ignored.
lines.en: Messages go out through each channel's API. Delivery, read and reply receipts come back as webhooks. Duplicates are ignored.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Voice calls run on Sarvam agents, in eight languages. Every call returns a disposition with a confidence score. Below the threshold, a person reviews it.
lines.en: Voice calls run on Sarvam agents, in eight languages. Every call returns a disposition with a confidence score. Below the threshold, a person reviews it.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Replies are understood by rules first, then a small model, then Sarvam's decision model. If it's still unsure, a human decides.
lines.en: Replies are understood by rules first, then a small model, then Sarvam's decision model. If it's still unsure, a human decides.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Inbound WhatsApp runs on its own state machine. No account details before OTP. Payment claims are checked against the bank, so doctored screenshots and reused references are caught.
lines.en: Inbound WhatsApp runs on its own state machine. No account details before OTP. Payment claims are checked against the bank, so doctored screenshots and reused references are caught.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: And a person can take control at any moment. Pause a campaign, approve or reject a held call, put a borrower on hold, or take over a conversation. Every action goes through Aladdin, and into the audit log.
lines.en: And a person can take control at any moment. Pause a campaign, approve or reject a held call, put a borrower on hold, or take over a conversation. Every action goes through Aladdin, and into the audit log.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every outcome is written back, and the model updates. Same data in, same decision out. Every step, on the record.
lines.en: Every outcome is written back, and the model updates. Same data in, same decision out. Every step, on the record.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Fifty thousand decisions in about two minutes. Zero cap breaches. And forty-nine out of forty-nine red-team attacks, blocked.
lines.en: Fifty thousand decisions in about two minutes. Zero cap breaches. And forty-nine out of forty-nine red-team attacks, blocked.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Kairos. Built to be trusted with every rupee, and every borrower.
lines.en: Kairos. Built to be trusted with every rupee, and every borrower.
